profile.evidence: The website explicitly identifies the business as a family-owned heating and air conditioning (HVAC) contractor that provides repair, installation, and maintenance for residential and commercial properties.

site_text: Larkmoor Comfort Heating & Air is a family-owned HVAC contractor in Larkmoor, Ohio: furnace and air conditioner repair, replacement, the Comfort Club maintenance plan, and commercial maintenance agreements across the north and east Columbus suburbs. Larkmoor Comfort Heating & Air Family-owned heating and air conditioning (HVAC) contractor since 1994. Service, repair and installation for homes and commercial buildings in Larkmoor, Westerville, Gahanna, New Albany, Delaware and the north and east Columbus suburbs of Ohio. Call (614) 555-0142 service@larkmoorcomfort.example Heating and cooling service and repair Furnaces, heat pumps, central air conditioners, ductless mini-splits, humidifiers and thermostats. Our licensed technicians repair all major brands. Same-day service when the schedule allows; after-hours emergency service through our answering service. System replacement When repair no longer makes sense, a Comfort Advisor visits your home, measures the house and gives you written options. Our install crews replace about 300 home systems a year. We are an authorized dealer for Aerovance heating and cooling equipment. Comfort Club maintenance plan Two tune-ups a year (spring cooling, fall heating), priority scheduling, no overtime charges and 15% off repairs. $189 per year. More than 600 neighbors are members. Commercial HVAC Preventive maintenance agreements, rooftop unit (RTU) service and replacement for offices, retail centers, churches, schools and property managers. Our commercial team maintains equipment for about 90 buildings in central Ohio. Request service Name Phone Address What is going on? Send request Requests sent through this form go to our office inbox. For no heat or no cooling, please call. About us Glen and Ruth Vossberg started Larkmoor Comfort in 1994 with one truck. Today about 35 people work here, including 14 service technicians and two install crews. Ohio HVAC contractor license on file. Hours: Monday to Friday 7:30 am to 5:00 pm; emergency service after hours. Follow us on Facebook . Larkmoor Comfort Heating & Air, Inc. | 2290 Fenwick Road, Larkmoor, OH | (614) 555-0142 Fictional company created for an academic test case. processes.description: Customers submit service requests via a website form or phone call; office staff log them on paper tickets and route urgent cases to an answering service for after-hours emergencies.

processes.name: Scheduling & Dispatch Management
processes.description: Office staff use a physical whiteboard and spreadsheet to assign jobs, prioritize Comfort Club members, and manage same-day or after-hours emergency calls across 14 technicians.

Difficulty balancing priority members with emergency requests

scored_opportunities.name: Automated Service Request Triage Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Parses incoming web forms and phone transcripts to extract customer details, HVAC system type, and urgency level, then auto-creates digital tickets and routes high-priority cases to the answering service or on-call technician.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual data entry from web forms to paper tickets and manual call routing.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by eliminating paper ticket entry and accelerating emergency routing; moderate effort to integrate with existing web forms; low risk as mandatory human review catches misclassifications before dispatch.

scored_opportunities.name: Priority-Based Scheduling Optimizer Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Analyzes technician locations, certifications, Comfort Club status, and job urgency to auto-suggest optimal daily routes and flag schedule conflicts for office staff approval.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual whiteboard/spreadsheet updates with version control issues and difficulty balancing priority members vs emergencies.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by resolving spreadsheet version control and priority conflicts; higher effort due to real-time location/skill data integration; moderate risk managed by mandatory human approval before finalizing routes.

scored_opportunities.name: Technician Job Site Documentation Assistant
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Uses voice-to-text and photo analysis to auto-populate service reports, track parts used against inventory lists, and generate warranty documentation for completed HVAC repairs.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual parts tracking on paper tickets and inconsistent work/warranty documentation.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Solid value by standardizing field documentation and reducing paper waste; moderate effort to build voice/image parsing; low risk due to straightforward verification by office staff before filing.

scored_opportunities.name: Load Calculation & Quote Drafting Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Processes home assessment notes and square footage data to run preliminary load calculations, draft replacement options with pricing tiers, and sync project timelines between Comfort Advisors and install crews.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual measurement/quoting process and coordination friction between advisors and install crews.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by streamlining 300+ annual quotes and crew coordination; higher effort due to HVAC load calculation complexity; moderate risk requires licensed advisor review before finalizing equipment sizing.

scored_opportunities.name: Comfort Club Renewal & Scheduling Coordinator Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Monitors 600+ membership expiration dates, auto-schedules bi-annual tune-ups prioritizing Comfort Club members, calculates overtime waivers, and flags scheduling conflicts for office staff.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual tracking of 600+ active memberships and manual calculation/application of overtime waivers.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: High value by automating renewal tracking and priority scheduling; low effort using existing CRM/calendar data; minimal risk as office staff manually confirm bookings before sending confirmations.

scored_opportunities.name: Commercial Service History Knowledge Base Agent
scored_opportunities.what_the_agent_does: Ingests historical work orders, contract terms, and equipment manuals for 90 commercial sites into a searchable AI knowledge base to enable quick retrieval of service history and contract details.
scored_opportunities.gap: Manual tracking of service history across diverse commercial sites and fragmented contract data.
scored_opportunities.rating_reason: Foundation work that unlocks other agents by centralizing fragmented data; moderate effort to clean and index historical records; very low risk as it only retrieves existing information without making autonomous decisions.

opportunities: Comfort Club Renewal & Scheduling Coordinator Agent
roadmaps.rationale: Starting with the Comfort Club agent captures recurring revenue and secures high-value memberships before tackling complex routing. The scheduling optimizer builds on that data to maximize technician utilization and reduce overtime costs. Finally, triage handles incoming demand efficiently once the core membership and routing logic are stable.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The Comfort Club agent is piloted first because it directly protects existing revenue streams with minimal technical complexity and immediate office staff adoption.
roadmaps.assumption: Office staff will consistently update membership expiration data in the existing system for the agent to function accurately.

rubric.objection: The sequencing assumes a level of data maturity that may not exist initially, potentially requiring significant upfront data cleaning and structuring before the agents can function effectively.

opportunities: Commercial Service History Knowledge Base Agent
Comfort Club Renewal & Scheduling Coordinator Agent
roadmaps.rationale: Establishing the knowledge base first creates a centralized data repository that all subsequent agents will depend on for accurate context and historical reference. The Comfort Club agent builds directly on this foundation to automate membership management using the newly structured data. The triage agent is implemented last because it requires robust historical and operational data streams to accurately parse urgency and route requests effectively.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The knowledge base is piloted first because it provides the essential data infrastructure required for all other automation agents to function correctly.
roadmaps.assumption: The business has sufficient digitized historical records and contract documents to populate the knowledge base with enough quality data to drive downstream automation.

rubric.objection: While the enabler approach is sound, it relies heavily on a successful knowledge base implementation which itself can be challenging to populate and maintain accurately.

opportunities: Commercial Service History Knowledge Base Agent
Comfort Club Renewal & Scheduling Coordinator Agent
roadmaps.rationale: Building the knowledge base first establishes a secure, read-only foundation that poses zero operational disruption to active field or office workflows. The Comfort Club agent follows as a low-risk automation that leverages existing scheduling processes without altering core operations. The field documentation assistant is deployed last because it introduces new hardware interactions with technicians, requiring proven stability from earlier steps.
roadmaps.pilot_reason: The knowledge base is piloted first because it operates passively in the background, eliminating any risk of disrupting active service calls or office operations.
roadmaps.assumption: Historical work orders and equipment manuals are digitized and accessible enough to be successfully ingested into the knowledge base without extensive manual cleanup.

rubric.objection: The Technician Job Site Documentation Assistant introduces hardware interaction, which could be problematic for technicians and requires a more robust testing phase.
